role: Core RR-interval and HRV-result model types: the beat point/series with timing helpers, artifact flags, time/frequency/nonlinear/ANS metric structs, training-context snapshot, the persisted HRVAnalysisResult, and localisation of its stored English window classification/selection-reason strings.
types: RRPoint: struct — one RR beat (t_ms cumulative start, rr_ms, optional wallClockMs and device HR), Codable/Equatable
RRSeries: struct — ordered RRPoints + sessionId + startDate with duration, gap and time-conversion helpers
ArtifactFlags: struct — per-beat artifact classification (isArtifact, ArtifactType, confidence, corrected)
TimeDomainMetrics: struct — meanRR, SDNN, RMSSD, pNN50, SDSD, HR stats (with hrRangeIsApproximate marking a mean ± SD stand-in range), triangular index; custom Codable with schemaVersion
FrequencyDomainMetrics: struct — VLF/LF/HF/LF:HF/total power + normalized units
NonlinearMetrics: struct — SD1/SD2, entropies, DFA α1/α2/R²
ANSMetrics: struct — stress/PNS/SNS indexes, HRV readiness, respiration, nocturnal HR dip
PeakCapacity: struct — highest sustained RMSSD window summary
TrainingContext: struct — ATL/CTL/TSB/yesterday TRIMP/VO2max/five most recent workouts snapshot frozen with a session
WorkoutSnapshot: struct — date/type/duration/load (userScaledLoad, stored as `trimp`) of one workout

HRVAnalysisResult: struct — complete persisted analysis for a window incl. window-selection provenance, overnight HR summary and estimatedMetrics (raw EstimatedMetric names an importer filled without a measurement)
HRVAnalysisResult.TimeRange: struct — Codable ms range for organized-recovery zones
EstimatedMetric: enum String — sdnn, pnn50, sdsd, sdHR, hrRange, sd1, sd2, sd1Sd2Ratio, beatCount (unknown count, 0 stored)
HRVAnalysisResult: extension — estimated-metric provenance (isEstimated, measured values, legacy Elite marking, display marker)
HRVAnalysisResult: extension — display (localized) window classification and selection reason
WindowSelectionReasonText: enum — parses WindowSelector's English reason strings back into numbers and re-renders them localized
toplevel: Codable synthesis for RRPoint, RRSeries, ArtifactFlags, FrequencyDomainMetrics, NonlinearMetrics, ANSMetrics, PeakCapacity, TrainingContext, WorkoutSnapshot, HRVAnalysisResult (persisted in the session archive / CloudKit payloads); TimeDomainMetrics has hand-written CodingKeys including schemaVersion and hrRangeIsApproximate. Static let ArtifactFlags.clean.
